proof_body:
by
  intro a b c
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases ha : a = 0
    · subst ha
      left
      have hb : b = 0 := by
        by_contra hb
        have := h (-c / b)
        have e : 0 * (-c / b) ^ 2 + b * (-c / b) + c = 0 := by
          field_simp
          ring
        rw [e] at this
        exact lt_irrefl _ this
      subst hb
      have := h 0
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl, by simpa using this⟩
    · right
      have key : ∀ x : ℝ, 4 * a * (a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c) = (2 * a * x + b) ^ 2 - (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c) := by
        intro x
        ring
      have ha0 : 0 < a := by
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne ha with h1 | h1
        · exfalso
          have hx := key ((|b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c| + 1 - b) / (2 * a))
          have e : 2 * a * ((|b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c| + 1 - b) / (2 * a)) + b = |b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c| + 1 := by
            field_simp
            ring
          rw [e] at hx
          have h3 : b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c ≤ |b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c| := le_abs_self _
          have h4 := abs_nonneg (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c)
          have h5 := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by linarith : 4 * a < 0) (h ((|b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c| + 1 - b) / (2 * a)))
          nlinarith
        · exact h1
      refine ⟨ha0, ?_⟩
      have hv := key (-b / (2 * a))
      have e0 : 2 * a * (-b / (2 * a)) + b = 0 := by
        field_simp
        ring
      rw [e0] at hv
      have h5 := mul_pos (by linarith : 0 < 4 * a) (h (-b / (2 * a)))
      nlinarith
  · rintro (⟨rfl, rfl, hc⟩ | ⟨ha, hD⟩) x
    · simpa using hc
    · have h := sq_nonneg (2 * a * x + b)
      by_contra hn
      push_neg at hn
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg ha.le (neg_nonneg.2 hn)]
